title: Special Executive Programme In Strategic Marketing
description: The course aims to equip learners with a deep understanding of strategic marketing and its impact on global consumer behaviour.
longDescription: This course explores the complex elements of consumer behavior, including mindset, interactions, and cultural influences. Learners will dive into global marketing strategies, consumer segmentation, and pricing models. Additionally, the course covers international marketing environments, trade policies, and branding strategies, with a focus on cross-cultural applicability. The learner will gain in-depth knowledge of the consumer mind and Behaviour, cultural and global forces that shape the consumer decision-making process, international branding, dealing with international trade barriers.
courseDetails: The course aims to equip students with a comprehensive understanding of strategic marketing, focusing on consumer behavior, cultural influences, and international marketing dynamics. It covers essential topics such as global branding strategies, market research processes, pricing objectives, and communication strategies. By examining cross-cultural perspectives and the localization of global consumer culture, students will learn to navigate the complexities of marketing in diverse environments.
